title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 7
description: Paper and verification programs (Julia, Lean 4) for "The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 7": every Voronoi cell of a unit-ball packing of R^7 has volume greater than 14.3234; some cells have volume 232/15 < 16; 232/15 is the exact minimum around the E7 kissing configuration.
